title: Spanish Linguist - Active Secret Clearance
description:
Spanish Linguist (Active Secret Clearance Required)
Key West, FL (On-site)
Relocation: Local candidates preferred; relocation at candidate’s expense (no relocation assistance provided)

ARC Group is seeking a highly skilled Spanish Linguist with an active Secret security clearance for an on-site opportunity in beautiful Key West, Florida. This position is ideal for candidates who are currently local to the area or are willing to relocate independently.

Our client is a rapidly growing organization with opportunities spanning language services, cultural advisory, training and instruction, IT, cybersecurity, and intelligence operations (including CI, HUMINT, SIGINT, and analysis roles). The selected candidate will provide mission-critical linguistic support to intelligence operations, enabling timely and informed operational decision-making.

Position Overview

The Spanish Linguist will support intelligence operations by providing advanced-level translation, interpretation, transcription, and analytical linguistic services across a wide range of classified and operational materials.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide linguistic support to CI, HUMINT, SIGINT, and OSINT missions through translation, interpretation, and exploitation of foreign-language materials
  • Deliver accurate translation, transcription, and interpretation of intelligence-related content
  • Translate and interpret materials including legal, technical, military, political, scientific, and government documents
  • Provide simultaneous interpretation during operational engagements, briefings, meetings, and conferences
  • Provide consecutive interpretation during interviews, debriefings, and operational discussions
  • Summarize documents, conduct bilingual comparisons, and support intelligence reporting requirements
  • Extract actionable intelligence from foreign-language sources in support of operational objectives
  • Maintain high standards of accuracy and professionalism in classified environments

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret security clearance
  • Spanish proficiency of 4+/4+ or higher (ILR scale)
  • English proficiency of 3+/3+ or higher (ILR scale)
  • Experience supporting CI, HUMINT, SIGINT, OSINT, or related intelligence operations
  • Experience with MEDEX, CELLEX, DOMEX, or similar intelligence exploitation processes
  • Demonstrated ability to provide accurate translation, transcription, and interpretation in operational settings
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to identify relevant intelligence information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting DoD, Intelligence Community (IC), or federal law enforcement missions
  • Prior deployed or operational intelligence experience in high-tempo environments
  • Familiarity with intelligence reporting standards and exploitation workflows
  • Experience working with classified intelligence operations
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a related field

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to apply advanced language expertise in direct support of mission-critical intelligence operations while working in a dynamic and expanding organization.

title: Tax Manager
description:
Tax Manager 
New York City or Melville, NY or Edison, NY 

ARC Group is partnering with a Top 15 CPA firm to identify an experienced Tax Manager to join their growing tax practice. This is an excellent opportunity for a tax professional with strong corporate tax expertise supporting large, multi-state, national, and global organizations. The ideal candidate will bring a combination of technical tax knowledge, leadership experience, and the ability to manage complex client engagements in a fast-paced public accounting environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage corporate tax engagements for large multi-state, national, and international clients across various industries.
  • Review and prepare federal, state, and local corporate income tax returns and related workpapers.
  • Lead ASC 740 income tax provision engagements, including deferred tax calculations, tax accounting, and financial statement disclosures.
  • Research complex tax issues and provide technical guidance and recommendations to clients and internal teams.
  • Manage client relationships, engagement timelines, budgets, and deliverables to ensure exceptional client service.
  • Supervise, mentor, and develop tax staff and senior associates.
  • Coordinate and collaborate with partners and cross-functional teams on tax planning and compliance strategies.
  • Assist with tax audits, notices, and responses to taxing authorities.
  • Stay current on federal, state, and international tax law developments and industry trends.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required.
  • Active CPA license issued by the State of New York required.
  • 4+ years of public accounting tax experience required.
  • Strong experience with Corporate Tax and ASC 740 required.
  • Experience supporting large multi-state, national, and/or global companies required.
  • Strong understanding of federal and state corporate tax compliance and tax provision processes.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, and client management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a large regional or national CPA firm environment.
  • Exposure to international tax concepts and complex corporate structures.
  • Leadership or team management experience preferred.

Additional Requirements

  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.
  • Ability to work a hybrid schedule with 3 days in-office and 2 days remote.

This is an outstanding opportunity to join a nationally recognized CPA firm offering strong career growth, exposure to sophisticated clients, and a collaborative team-oriented culture.

title: In-House Corporate Counsel
description:
In-House Corporate Counsel
Boca Raton, FL | On-Site 
 

ARC Group is seeking an experienced In-House Corporate Counsel to support a large-scale retirement and financial services platform. This role has a primary focus on ERISA and employee benefits compliance, with additional responsibilities in corporate contracts, securities regulation, and investment-related legal matters.

The position offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative in-house legal environment supporting approximately 350,000 members and over $1 billion in assets, while partnering closely with senior legal leadership.

Key Responsibilities

ERISA & Employee Benefits Compliance (Primary Focus)

  • Serve as the primary legal resource for ERISA-related matters, including fiduciary duties and plan governance
  • Support compliance and administration of 401(k) and retirement plan platforms
  • Manage and respond to DOL and IRS inquiries, audits, and regulatory matters

Corporate & Contract Law

  • Draft, review, and negotiate corporate contracts, vendor agreements, and related documentation
  • Provide legal guidance on commercial agreements and operational matters

Securities & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support SEC filings, disclosures, and compliance requirements
  • Assist with interpretation of federal securities regulations

Investment & Labor Compliance

  • Advise on investment-related legal issues
  • Support compliance with Department of Labor (DOL) and IRS regulations
  • Assist with labor and employment-related compliance matters

Additional Responsibilities

  • Provide legal support for bonus and incentive compensation plans
  • Respond to demand letters and other ad hoc legal matters
  • Support general corporate legal needs as required

Qualifications

Required:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school
  • Active license to practice law in at least one U.S. state
  • Minimum 5+ years of post-qualification legal experience
  • Experience in corporate law, contracts, ERISA/employee benefits, or related areas
  • Strong knowledge of ERISA, SEC, DOL, and IRS regulatory frameworks
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication skills
  • Ability to work on-site in a collaborative environment

Preferred:

  • Prior in-house counsel experience
  • Experience with retirement plans, 401(k) platforms, or financial services organizations
  • Background in securities, labor/employment, or investment compliance
  • Strong business judgment and ability to provide practical legal guidance
